1.web: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
1.asv: O God thou hast cast us off, thou hast broken us down; Thou hast been angry; oh restore us again.

2.web: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
2.asv: Thou hast made the land to tremble; thou hast rent it: Heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

3.web: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
3.asv: Thou hast showed thy people hard things: Thou hast made us to drink the wine of staggering.

4.web: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
4.asv: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, That it may be displayed because of the truth. [Selah

5.web: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
5.asv: That thy beloved may be delivered, Save with thy right hand, and answer us.

6.web: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
6.asv: God hath spoken in his holiness: I will exult; I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

7.web: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
7.asv: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

8.web: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my shoe on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
8.asv: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom will I cast my shoe: Philistia, shout thou because of me.

9.web: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
9.asv: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who hath led me unto Edom?

10.web: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
10.asv: Hast not thou, O God, cast us off? And thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts.

11.web: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
11.asv: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.

12.web: Through God we shall do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
12.asv: Through God we shall do valiantly; For he it is that will tread down our adversaries.
